name: Eightfold AI
bestFor: Large-enterprise talent intelligence: AI matching across sourcing, internal mobility, and workforce planning
description: A talent intelligence platform that uses AI to match candidates and employees to roles across acquisition, internal mobility, and workforce planning, built for very large organizations.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; enterprise sales process

paidTier.notes: No published pricing; each module (talent acquisition, talent management, workforce exchange) is scoped and quoted separately. Analyst estimates put costs around $7–$10 per employee/month, with large-enterprise annual contracts commonly reported in the $150K–$500K+ range — not official figures.

name: HireVue
bestFor: AI-assisted video interviewing and candidate screening at hiring scale
description: A hiring platform combining on-demand video interviews with AI-assisted screening and assessments, integrated into enterprise ATS workflows to speed up high-volume hiring.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; request-a-demo sales process

paidTier.notes: No published self-serve pricing. Three packages (Essential, Enterprise, Premium) are quoted by sales; third-party procurement data (Vendr) reports contracts averaging roughly $49,855/year, typically $35K–$145K+, plus $15K–$40K implementation — reported figures, not an official price list.

name: Lattice
bestFor: AI-assisted performance management, engagement, and an HR agent that answers people-data questions
description: A people management platform (performance reviews, goals, engagement surveys, HRIS) that added a standalone AI Agent to answer HR questions, coach managers, and act on people data.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; $4,000/year minimum, annual contracts only

paidTier.notes: The separate 'Foundations HRIS' product is no longer listed. Current base products: Performance $10/seat/month, Goals & OKRs $8/seat/month, Engagement $4/seat/month (all include 1:1s, Weekly Updates, Feedback, Q&A Boards, Analytics, AI Agent, and Integrations). Add-ons: Compensation +$6/seat/month, Grow +$4/seat/month. Modular, stacked pricing rather than flat tiers.

name: Paradox (Olivia)
bestFor: Conversational AI recruiting for high-volume, frontline and hourly hiring over SMS and chat
description: A conversational recruiting assistant, Olivia, that screens candidates and books interviews over SMS, WhatsApp, and web chat, built for high-volume frontline and hourly hiring at companies like Chipotle and General Motors. Acquired by Workday in a deal that closed October 2025.

freeTier.limits: No free tier or trial; demo-and-quote sales process, typically 12-month minimum contracts

paidTier.notes: No published pricing. Industry-reported figures: entry packages around $1,000–$1,500/month for basic conversational screening and scheduling, mid-market deployments $3,000–$8,000/month, and full enterprise rollouts $25,000–$100,000+/year, scaling with hiring volume and locations — not official figures. Workday completed its acquisition of Paradox in 2025, so packaging may move toward Workday bundles.

name: Workday Illuminate
bestFor: Enterprise HCM AI agents built directly into Workday's own HR and finance data platform
description: A family of AI agents built into the Workday platform — including recruiting, payroll, and HR-service agents — trained on Workday's own HR and financial transaction data, with usage metered through a Flex Credits model layered on top of core Workday subscriptions.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; requires an existing Workday HCM subscription plus Flex Credits

paidTier.notes: No published price list. Core Workday HCM licensing is reported to start around $34 per employee/month (PEPM), with Illuminate AI agent usage metered separately through Workday Flex Credits, a consumption-based add-on — both scoped and quoted per deployment.
